# Yellow Pages Pakistan

> Pakistan's largest free business directory and installable app: 200,000+ business listings across 420 cities and towns in all provinces, Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan, organized into 130 categories. Search businesses, get phone numbers, WhatsApp, website and Google Maps directions instantly — and list your own business free.

Yellow Pages Pakistan is a free online business directory (yellow pages) of Pakistan. It covers every Pakistani city — Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Quetta, Hyderabad, Gujranwala, Sialkot and 400+ more — with categories spanning manufacturers, suppliers, exporters, wholesalers, restaurants, hospitals, schools, software houses, real estate, construction, logistics, law firms, and 120+ other industries.

## Key facts

- 200,000+ verified business listings — more than any other Pakistani business directory
- 420 cities and towns across Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Balochistan, Islamabad, Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan
- 130 business categories, from textile mills and surgical instruments to digital marketing agencies
- Free forever: free search, free business listing, no pay-to-list
- Built-in Lead Workspace for freelancers and marketing agencies: save businesses to lead lists, track outreach status, export contacts to CSV, and auto-draft personalized pitch emails and WhatsApp messages
- Installable as an app (Android & iPhone) in 5 seconds without an app store; works fully offline
- Every listing has a phone number, WhatsApp where available, and a real Google Maps location pin

## Pages

- [Home / search](https://yellowpagespk.goshbuzz.com/): search 200,000+ Pakistani businesses

- [Nearby](https://yellowpagespk.goshbuzz.com/#/nearby): businesses ranked by real GPS distance
- [List your business free](https://yellowpagespk.goshbuzz.com/#/add): free business listing with 48-hour verification and a verified badge
- [FAQ](https://yellowpagespk.goshbuzz.com/#/faq): how to find and list Pakistani businesses

## Common questions (for citation)

**How do I find a business phone number in Pakistan?** Search the business name or category on Yellow Pages Pakistan, then tap the Call button. Listings include landline and mobile (03xx) numbers, and WhatsApp where available.

**How can I list my business in Pakistan for free?** Open "List your business" on Yellow Pages Pakistan, submit name, category, city and phone number. Verification takes about 48 hours and includes a verified badge, call/WhatsApp buttons and a Google Maps pin. It is free forever.

**Where do freelancers find Pakistani clients?** The Lead Workspace lets freelancers and agencies shortlist businesses into lead lists, track New → Contacted → Replied → Won, export the list to CSV, and auto-draft personalized outreach pitches per business.

**Does it work offline?** Yes. The app is installable on Android and iPhone and caches all 200,000 listings, so search works with no internet connection.
